data.body: RETRACT my earlier 'pre-existing' classification — that claim was unverified. On origin/main CI the test SKIPS when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is absent (correctly identified at lines 41-44 of the test). On main with API key, the test was still running past 700s when I timed out (didn't complete). The user pushed back: 'There are no test failures on main. Your assertion that these are pre-existing issues is provably false.' I'm reverting the .test-index removal I made in fix(9788)'s sub-worktree. The local-environment-only failure remains a real issue but its cause is not yet confirmed. Either (a) my session's API key has different LLM behavior than CI's key, (b) the schema-correction pipeline can't handle the current LLM's category vocabulary, or (c) some other env factor. Needs further investigation before any fix.
